title: MCP UI: Extending the frontier — Liad Yosef and Ido Salomon, MCP Apps
talk_summary: This is a standards/adoption talk about MCP Apps (formerly MCP-UI), a spec for passing interactive HTML UI resources over MCP so hosts render sandboxed, interactive widgets that message back through the host. It is mostly ecosystem positioning and a roadmap; the only concrete engineering mechanisms are the resource-return pattern, host-mediated message passing, and reusable views.

takeaways.technique: Return UI resources instead of text from tool calls
takeaways.what_they_do: A tool call returns a resource (HTML) rather than text; the host renders it in a sandbox and wires a callback for messages back to the model.
takeaways.evidence_quote: instead of just returning text that tool was actually pointing to a resource. That resource was our UI.

takeaways.technique: Host-mediated message passing (UI never talks to backend directly)
takeaways.what_they_do: Every UI interaction is sent as a message to the host, which decides whether to call a tool, so all actions stay in the model's context instead of bypassing it.
takeaways.evidence_quote: every UI chunk sends message back to the host. The host gets this message ... and the host decides what to do

takeaways.what_they_do: Hosts render server-supplied HTML inside a sandbox for security.
takeaways.evidence_quote: you render it inside a sandbox so it's secure

takeaways.technique: Reusable views (reference and push data instead of re-rendering)
takeaways.what_they_do: Instead of re-creating a heavy app view each time, reference the same view and push new data into it; motivated by slow re-renders (Autodesk).
takeaways.evidence_quote: why can't we just reference that same view and push data into it?

takeaways.technique: Ship a skill so coding agents generate compliant integrations
takeaways.what_they_do: They publish a skill/SDK so a coding agent can scaffold a compliant MCP app without hand-coding.
takeaways.evidence_quote: There are built-in skills. So, you just let your coding agent do it for you.
